name: LVMH CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton SE is a luxury group with six business groups: holding companies, selective retailing, watches and jewelry, perfumes and cosmetics, fashion and leather, and wines and spirits. Products include champagne and sparkling wine, vodka and white liquor, luggage, bags, shoes, clothing and beauty items.
